insert.authority: Owner-selected existing Lacuna stock profile; RX-M3x5.7 manufacturer nominal dimensions. Actual stock measurements and physical fit remain untested.

screw.authority: M3 x 8 is part of the owner-confirmed Lacuna M3 socket-head stock (M3x8, M3x16 and M3x20); used for R5, R7 and R8. Nominal maximum head envelope diameter 6 x height 3. Count and inspect before assembly. M3 x 16 and M3 x 20 are too long for this joint.

print_scope: Two hardened compact housing first articles on one plate: two identical DXF-verified R9 bases (fixing R8's front bump underside-component collision), one PoE lid (ZERO 3E + RA023 HAT at 14.5 mm official copper-pillar spacing, device side) and one bare lid (ZERO 3E only, computer side, with top-DXF-cleared retention ribs). Unloaded shell fit can be checked first; complete modules, cable fit and powered cooling remain NOT RUN.

poe_mounting.description: Use the Radxa-supplied M2.5 x 14.5 mm insulated copper pillars and eight CM2.5 x 4 screws. They carry live IEEE 802.3af/at PoE voltage (up to 57 V): keep them installed, tightened and insulated. No case fastener substitutes for them and no vent or metal path exposes them.
poe_mounting.modeling: Official Radxa RA023 BOM specifies 4 x M2.5 x 14.5 mm copper pillars fixing the facing PCB gap at 14.5 mm. The case keeps diameter-8 reservations clear through full housing height on every printed part (base, poe-lid, bare-lid), and all roof and side vents stay at least 6.4 mm away from the four corner mounting axes.

bare_mounting.description: Computer-side ZERO 3E without HAT, powered from the computer USB-C OTG port. Its mounting holes remain wired to the RJ45 centre taps, so the case leaves them empty and shrouded: no printed peg, case fastener, vent or metal reaches them.

not_required: No clips, clip screws, standoffs, nylon screws or other hardware beyond eight M3 x 8 screws, eight RX-M3x5.7 inserts and the Radxa-supplied PoE HAT kit.
